environment: isolated hosted Windows Server 2025, Qt 6.8.3 Windows QPA
qualification_scope: Changed Windows observers and actual shown ASCII multiline only; not a full ordinary, IME, audio, scene-visual or distribution rerun

actual_multiline.capture: PrintWindow of shown test-owned parent dialogs, full EDIT clients including real caret; no screen capture
actual_multiline.input: actual OS SendInput and cursor moves in guarded isolated session; focus and caret ownership asserted; thread-local WH_GETMESSAGE confirms move delivery; independent gestures wait the OS double-click interval
actual_multiline.comparison: every RGB pixel, actual caret rectangle and directional selection; no masks, color transforms, skipped failures or threshold changes

visual_review.scope: unscaled native/Qt pairs for three languages, selected/long/scrolled text, supplemental to all 72 exact comparisons

unaccepted_scope: outside-client drag/autoscroll against actual original EDIT
complete non-Windows shown appearance and popup qualification
physical mixed-DPI monitor transitions in a separate test session
